text:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — I want to lock in a 2-day enablement week for Acme next month: office hours + two hands-on trainings + a targeted workshop to address their integration questions. Proposed dates: Tue 2025-06-10 & Wed 2025-06-11. Anyone object?

Josh (Solutions Eng): +1 from me. Can cover model routing and cost controls on day 1. What time zone for Acme? They're PST.

Priya (Onboarding): PST works. Suggest we schedule office hours 10:00–11:30 PST both days, trainings 12:30–14:00 PST, and a 90m workshop the afternoon of day 2 focused on rollout/risk mitigation.

Maria (CSM): That timeslot looks good. Main goals from my side: (1) onboard their SREs to console & tracing, (2) walk through Dedicated vs Hosted fallback policies, (3) collect feedback for renewal. Aaron, can you draft the workshop agenda?

Aaron (Enablement): Draft agenda below — open to edits:

```
Day 1: Intro + Office Hours
- 10:00 Office hours: quick Q&A
- 12:30 Training: Console walkthrough (dashboards, tokens, billing)
- 13:30 Training: Model tuning + batches

Day 2: Deep Dive + Workshop
- 10:00 Office hours
- 12:30 Training: Dedicated capacity & autoscaling
- 14:30 Workshop: Renewal-risk mitigation playbook, runbook write-up
```

Sam (Acme): From Acme's side: SREs prefer hands-on labs. Can you include a short lab to simulate failover to model variant? Also we'll invite our infra lead, Maya.

Josh (Solutions Eng): Good call — will prep a small lab: we'll include a scripted failover using `redwood rollout set --variant small_v1` and a traffic-shaping example. I'll attach commands tomorrow.

Priya (Onboarding): I'll own invites and Miro board for the workshop. Maria — do we want to run a 10-question pulse survey at the end to capture enablement efficacy and renewal signals?

Maria (CSM): Yes please. Use this 3-tier question set: adoption intent, blockers, renewal confidence (1–5). Add free text for 'what would make this easier'. Priya, can you wire that into the workshop wrap-up? @OpsBot can you create a calendar poll draft?

OpsBot: Calendar poll draft created: https://cal.poll/ACME-enablement-1748001234 — participants: Sam, Maya, Acme-SREs, Maria, Josh, Priya, Aaron.

Aaron (Enablement): Sounds good. Action items:
- Priya: send invites + pulse survey (due 2 days after workshops)
- Josh: lab + commands (attach by 1748002500)
- Maria: capture renewal risk notes during workshop; escalate to AE if confidence <=3
- Sam: send list of attendees + preferred SSH keys for labs

Sam (Acme): Thanks — will send attendee list by EOD tomorrow.

Maria (CSM): Perfect. I'll post a short pre-read this Friday with objectives & pre-reqs (console access, API key, sample dataset). :thumbsup:

Josh (Solutions Eng): I'll include a short snippet for setting up test data:

```
# small sample load
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"test dataset gen\", \"max_tokens\":64}'
```

Priya (Onboarding): All set on my side. Closing thread — will follow up with invites and poll results.

Maria (CSM): Thanks team. Closing out here — tag me if anything changes. :calendar:
